name: Pick Your AI USD research cost policy
description: Project-authored preview of the #39 USD default-currency proposal. This research definition does not establish production adoption, runtime enforcement, a free billing classification, currency conversion, a region default or complete cost coverage.

provenance.notes: The source proposes USD pricing with explicit T0 display currency; it does not record production adoption. This dated preview defines its own identity and USD default in the same research note's USD cost-policy preview section. The existing vendor prices and regional examples are not rechecked or adopted by this candidate.

Frozen pricing semantics preserve source currencies, require an explicit pinned exchange-rate policy for conversion, and prohibit unknown billing from being treated as zero. This preview supplies no FX or hard-cap implementation and does not establish a complete quote or budget pass.
